description: This file contains implementations related to motion activity detection and pedometer data collection within an Android application. It includes data classes for requests and records, a data source interface with a system-based implementation, and a MotionHandler class that manages motion activity and pedometer operations, including permission checks, data retrieval, and JSON parsing.

classes.name: MotionActivityRequest
classes.description: Represents a request for motion activity data, including optional start and end timestamps and a limit.

classes.name: MotionPedometerRequest
classes.description: Represents a request for pedometer data with optional start and end timestamps.

classes.name: MotionActivityRecord
classes.description: Holds data about detected motion activity, including activity confidence and type flags.

classes.name: PedometerRecord
classes.description: Holds pedometer data such as steps, distance, and floors climbed.

classes.name: MotionDataSource
classes.description: Interface to check motion data capabilities and perform data retrieval operations.

classes.name: SystemMotionDataSource
classes.description: Implementation of MotionDataSource using Android system sensors for real-time data.

classes.name: MotionHandler
classes.description: Main class for managing motion activity and pedometer data retrieval, including permission checks and JSON parsing.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity
methods.description: Handles a request for motion activity data, returning measurement results in a GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer
methods.description: Handles a request for pedometer data, returning measurement results in a GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if either motion activity or pedometer data sources are available.

methods.name: isActivityAvailable
methods.description: Checks if motion activity detection is available.

methods.name: isPedometerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if pedometer functionality is available.

methods.name: parseActivityRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a MotionActivityRequest object.

methods.name: parsePedometerRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a MotionPedometerRequest object.
